Awarded on this
10th day of June, 2025
Certificate of Excellence in Legal Practice

THE NATIONAL ASSOCIATION 
OF DISTINGUISHED ATTORNEYS
Has demonstrated exceptional legal expertise and outstanding professional excellence in the
practice of law. Through distinguished service to clients and exemplary contributions to the legal
profession, the above-named attorney has earned recognition as a practitioner of the highest caliber.
Area of Practice: Criminal Defense Law
The Rt. Hon. Dame Margaret Foster

This distinction is awarded to attorneys who demonstrate: excellence in legal representation, 
professional integrity, contribution to legal scholarship, service to the community.
